title: SendGrid Event Webhook signature verification fails on real deliveries
symptoms: verifySignature returns false for live events
Verification passes for a single test event and fails for batched events
Works in unit tests with sample payload, fails behind Express
cause: The ECDSA signature covers the timestamp header plus the raw request bytes, including the line breaks SendGrid puts between batched events. Parsing and re-stringifying the JSON changes those bytes.
fix: Capture the raw body before any JSON middleware and verify against it with the public key from the Event Webhook security settings.
apply: app.post('/sg-events', express.raw({ type: 'application/json' }), (req, res) => { const ew = new EventWebhook(); const ok = ew.verifySignature(ew.convertPublicKeyToECDSA(PUBLIC_KEY), req.body, req.get('X-Twilio-Email-Event-Webhook-Signature'), req.get('X-Twilio-Email-Event-Webhook-Timestamp')); res.sendStatus(ok ? 200 : 403); });
affected: SendGrid signed Event Webhook, @sendgrid/eventwebhook and sendgrid-python helpers, as of 2026-10
